# Fonsviva

> The shared local compute and model-serving layer for UntoCaesar, Gantrel and UniCerebrum. Status: planned, not released; check SUPPORTED.md before doing any step.

Cloud providers are personal use only and live only in Fonsviva. Apps never hold provider keys. UntoCaesar client work and UniCerebrum are blocked from cloud.

## Setup
- [For agents: quickstart](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/agents): rules and order of steps
- [Install](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/install): steps, checks, expected output
- [Connect apps and agents](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/connect-fonsviva)
- [Select models](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/select-models)
- [Add a cloud provider](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/add-cloud-provider)
- [Troubleshoot](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/setup/troubleshoot)

## Project
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/baney75/Fonsviva/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents working on the code

## Reference
- [Architecture](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/ARCHITECTURE): what Fonsviva builds on and adds
- [Model manager](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/MODELS): installed models and getting new ones
- [Connect agents](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/CONNECT): setup per coding harness
- [Cloud rules](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/CLOUD): personal use only, blocks and legal basis
- [Providers](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/providers): vetted cloud providers with sources
- [Adding compute](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/COMPUTE): machines, nodes, cloud; keychain keys, pairing, revoke
- [Costs](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/COSTS): power and cloud cost, budgets, spend protection
- [Jobs](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/JOBS): job types, statuses and CLI
- [Storage](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/STORAGE): disk use, dedupe, move, cleanup, quotas
- [Keys](https://baney75.github.io/Fonsviva/KEYS): org keys, scopes, limits, agent-made keys, safe sharing
